verdict.rationale: OpenTofu provides a basic review-gate building block: `tofu plan` previews changes, a plan can be saved with `-out=FILE` and later applied exactly as reviewed, and speculative plans can be checked before code review. Enforcing least-privilege credentials, approval gates, or policy that stops an agent from applying unapproved changes is not shown and would need external CI or approval tooling. Missing for 10: least-privilege or scoped credential mechanisms, built-in approval/review gate enforcement, policy-as-code checks on plans, agent-specific guardrail documentation, independent corroboration.
